picks.title: Corey, Part 2: What Do You Build After Faith?
picks.summary:
What happens after the beliefs that once gave your life structure, meaning, and certainty no longer work for you?
In Part 2 of our conversation with Corey Buse, we follow his story from a committed returned missionary and young husband to the moment his wife, Emily, tells him she may be ready to leave the Church.
That forces Corey to examine his own faith from the ground up. We talk about the questions and church history that eventually changed his beliefs, but more importantly, we explore what came next.
How do you rebuild meaning without a prescribed plan? Where do values come from when the
picks.reason: Personal story of faith loss and rebuilding after leaving LDS beliefs.
